description: The MoE knob set flip merged onto the verify row fusions and f32_row_tiles adoptions: the knobs lane's declaration (moe-direct-knobs.json) regenerated for the merge's positions. Its 32 shared fixtures carry the same module activations, handle counts and operation edits; the row fusions' prefix capture fixture loads the knob module on each rank, resolves its 15 entries per rank and releases them at destroy, like every other completed DSpark lifetime. The direct MoE knob set (stream, keep, retire and loads) becomes the served route of the Flash TP4 absorbing path at its 32- to 64-row buckets through the MoE tuning table; the wide verify buckets keep the plain route. Every fixture that prepares the backbone bank's direct MoE at TP4 loads the unchanged locked module bandwidth_moe_deepseek41_knobs_sm120 once per rank and resolves its 15 entries. The absorbing gate queue, two-strip down queue, gate finisher and down finisher of the 32-row buckets launch their knob entries with every other field unchanged, and each completed destroy releases the added symbols and module.
